_comment: Named OpenAI-compatible AI providers (gateways/routers) offered in `secator x ai setup` on top of LiteLLM's built-in catalog. To add one, append an entry here (data only, no code) or in a user file at <SECATOR_DIRS_DATA>/ai_providers.json (which overrides entries by `name`). Per-entry schema: name (id), label (display), api_base (https OpenAI-compatible base, incl. /v1), docs (optional URL), key_hint (optional key prefix shown as a hint). Models are listed live from `<api_base>/models` at setup time, so no model list is hardcoded here.
